label: Gate
blurb: An approval queue: allow, deny, or edit-then-allow, each with a reason.

pending.doc: each { id, title, detail?, command?, risk?: low|medium|high, by? }

decided.doc: each { id, title, verdict: allow|deny|edit, reason?, reasonAddedAt?, editedTo?, at, by, ask, undone?, undoneAt? }

controls.label: Allow
controls.doc: Approve the request. Nothing executes — the agent that asked reads the verdict.

controls.label: Edit
controls.title: Change it before allowing it
controls.doc: Change the command, then allow the edited version.

controls.label: add why
controls.title: Say why, now or whenever you are asked. It will be marked as written after the fact.
controls.doc: Add or change the reason on a decided row; it is stamped as written late.

controls.label: undo
controls.title: Put this back in the queue. The agent may already have acted on it.
controls.doc: Reverse a verdict. The reversal stays on the record.

gestures: a reason is optional but it is what the agent learns from
nothing here executes — the agent that asked reads your verdict
notes: Nothing here executes — a verdict is a record the asking agent reads.
Pair with `./board -wait -for "answer <tabId>"` or a stale queue lets the human believe they gated something that already ran.
`ask` preserves the original request so an undo can restore it faithfully.
A reason can be added after the verdict; `reasonAddedAt` marks it as reconstructed rather than recorded.
